comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
Recipe comes from NPC Anita (town's man recipe) in Lorenzo's palace in Florence. Recipe name is "Making Platinum Hair Ornament", Requires R12 Handicraft and 400 Handicraft Contribution Points.

Ingredients : 10x Silverwork + 5x High-grade Amethyst + 10x High-grade Platinum

+1 Metal Trading
+1 Seasoning Trading

Since it needed High-grade Platinum, make sure to be well prepared for big time spending gemstone digging activity.

This is only for female toons.
